text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Change in per capita CO₂ emissions and GDP
Consumption-based emissions include those from fossil fuels and industry. Land-use change emissions are not
included. GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

tspan.tspan: Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026); Global Carbon Budget (2025); Population based on various sources (2024)
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices.
